prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished desktop UX/UI review image of ONLY section 2 of the Órbita agency landing page, using the provided image exclusively as its visual reference. Output requested PNG exactly 1440 by 960 actual pixels, landscape 3:2, frontal flat screenshot, no device frame, no perspective, no navigation bar, no footer from the website, no watermark.

Preserve the reference's editorial ivory #f6f3eb, near-black #0b0d0b, muted green #48622e and lime #c7f45b identity. Crisp modern typography, Manrope-like strong headings and DM Sans-like body, excellent Spanish spelling and accents. Ivory full canvas, wide centered warm-white report container with soft rounded corners, fine border and very subtle shadow. Clear whitespace and consistent margins. Refine alignment and readability; no decorative charts or unnecessary controls. Lime is an accent fill, NEVER small lime text on ivory.

Top introduction: small uppercase label “TRANSPARENCIA”. Large left-aligned title on exactly TWO lines:
“Ves la inversión.”
“Entiendes las decisiones.”
Right-hand supporting text:
“Un ejemplo de lo que revisas: inversión, resultados y próximos pasos.”

Report dark header bar:
Left “Reporte de ejemplo · 1–30 septiembre de 2026”
Right pill “Vista ilustrativa de reporte”
Directly below, a clearly visible clarification: “Dos ejemplos de negocios distintos”.

Inside the report: TWO clearly separated rows, matching column widths and typographic hierarchy. A slim left identity column per row, then THREE large metric columns, with the first result metric softly highlighted in pale lime #eef7d6 and a fine lime border. Numbers equally prominent and black, units smaller. No numerical aggregation and no comparing these two different businesses. Channel marks may match the small Google Ads and Instagram identifiers in the reference, but are merely example campaign-source identity, no fictitious connected messaging/software interface.

ROW 1 left identity: “Google Ads” with “Ejemplo 1 · Tienda online”.
Three metrics verbatim:
1: “$412.800 CLP” with label “Ventas atribuidas a los anuncios.”
2: “$129.000 CLP” with label “Inversión publicitaria.”
3: “3,2x” with label “Retorno en anuncios · ROAS.” and the legible explanation “Por cada $1 en anuncios, $3,2 en ventas atribuidas.”
Below these metrics, a calm cream action strip split into two readable columns, with uppercase small labels:
“QUÉ HICIMOS” / “Destacamos los productos más vendidos.”
“QUÉ SIGUE” / “Probar una oferta de envío para aumentar las compras.”

ROW 2 left identity: “Instagram” with “Meta Ads · Ejemplo 2 · Servicios”.
Three metrics verbatim:
1: “15” with label “Formularios recibidos.” and subline “Solicitudes de cotización.”
2: “$73.440 CLP” with label “Inversión publicitaria.”
3: “$4.896 CLP” with label “Por formulario recibido.”
Below metrics, matching cream action strip in two columns:
“QUÉ HICIMOS” / “Aclaramos cómo solicitar una cotización.”
“QUÉ SIGUE” / “Probar otro anuncio y revisar la calidad de las consultas.”

Bottom area within the report: two compact but LEGIBLE dark-gray notes, left aligned:
“Ejemplos ilustrativos. No son una promesa de resultados.”
“Inversión en anuncios sin honorarios de gestión. ROAS no equivale a ganancia.”
On the right, a visible rounded lime button with black text “Agenda una reunión →”.

All requested text must fit entirely inside the 1440x960 canvas, including the bottom notes and CTA, with no clipping. Body labels about 18px, action copy 15–16px or larger, small notes at least 14px at actual requested size. Long sentences may wrap onto two clean lines. Keep report fully legible, not a miniaturized dashboard. No added statistics, clicks, people counts, guarantees, commercial tariffs or invented actions. No “Lo revisas en GISBA”, no GISBA product interface or claims, no production instructions or A/B/C/Z review labels printed in the image. Every requested figure and agency action is merely an illustrative example, not a real campaign result. This is solely a review image; do not build a website.
